title: Barycentric and Tetrahedral Subdivision
negative_results: from_barycentric refuses coordinates that do not sum to 1
child_index refuses a point outside the parent triangle
to_barycentric refuses a direction that does not radially intersect the triangle plane

claims.statement: Local barycentric coordinates on a spherical triangle round-trip exactly (point<->barycentric) via radial projection and affine reconstruction.

One-to-eight (octal) refinement splits a triangle into 8 children (indices 0..7) that tile the parent exactly; child_index is the exact inverse of refine (refine-then-locate returns the same child), and both are deterministic.
A barycentric coordinate and a child index are positions within a synthetic tessellation. SOURCE_VECTOR_GEOGRAPHIC_SEMANTICS_NOT_CLAIMED; PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.
